bio: A stoic, calculating figure of middling years with hands now more dusted with flour than callused from dockwork, Antonio Contarini has transformed from facchino to respected business owner. His once-weathered face retains the memory of decades hauling cargo under the Venetian sun, but now bears the thoughtful expression of a man who has risen through society through sheer determination.
